prompt:
Summarise the supplied source text in at most 100 words. Be concise and objective.
Report only information supported by the source. Attribute claims, opinions, and
projections to their authors or speakers, and preserve uncertainty and
qualifications; do not present disputed claims as established facts. Do not add

summary: IDFC Alternatives is in advanced talks to invest Rs.600 crore in ACME Solar, according to two people familiar with the matter. ACME chairman Manoj Upadhyay said the company was in touch with investors but declined to comment further; IDFC declined to comment. The investment would help fund ACME’s solar projects across India. Investor interest follows $1.55 billion invested in Indian renewable energy in 2015, according to VCCEdge. Deloitte’s Debasish Mishra said India’s ambitious clean-energy targets were achievable with stable regulation. Deutsche Bank forecast 34 GW of solar capacity by 2020, citing distribution-company finances and grid constraints.
